messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to use the get_stock_prices function to fetch Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN) and Tesla (TSLA). They want separate durations: "1 week", "2 weeks", "3 weeks" and "1 month". The request says "for each company respectively"? Actually they say "蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價". That could mean:

Apple - 1 week
Microsoft - 2 weeks
Amazon - 3 weeks
Tesla - 1 month.

We need to call get_stock_prices with appropriate parameters. But we can only pass one set at a time? The function signature expects an array of companies and a single duration. We might have to make multiple calls or combine them into one call but then they'd all share same duration which isn't what requested. So likely we should do four separate calls.

But maybe we can provide a combined list like ["AAPL","MSFT","AMZN","TSLA"] and specify duration as something else? No.

Thus best approach: Make four calls sequentially. Provide results accordingly.

We'll produce JSON output from function calls. We'll first call for AAPL with duration "1 week".

Then MSFT with "2 weeks"

Then AMZN with "3 weeks"

Then TSLA with "1 month"

Return data aggregated.

Let's proceed.
